summary:
Implementation plan to fix the Signal Discovery Radar:
1. Fix repetitive account scans by tracking excluded IDs across tracked and discovered accounts, rotating pool indexes, and synthesizing fresh high-intent accounts via Gemini AI when the catalog is exhausted.
2. Add multi-select checkboxes (including 'Select All' and individual selection) to the Signal Discovery Radar table.
3. Add a batch action 'Add Selected to Tracked Target Accounts' with instant promotion, removing promoted accounts from the Radar view as requested.
4. Comprehensive QA & verification.
